Bill.BriefDescription: Providing notice of release from involuntary treatment.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing notice of release from involuntarytreatment; and adding a new section to chapter 71.05 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 71.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Whenever a person who is the subject of an involuntary commitmentorder under this chapter is discharged from an evaluation and treatmentfacility or state hospital, the evaluation and treatment facility orstate hospital shall provide notice of the person's discharge to thedesignated mental health professional office responsible for theinitial commitment and the designated mental health professional officethat serves the county in which the person is expected to reside, andshall provide these offices with a copy of any less restrictive orderor conditional release entered with respect to the person. Thisnotice, along with a copy of any less restrictive order or conditionalrelease, shall be provided by the date of the discharge if practicable,and in no event later than on the calendar day following discharge.Notice is not required under this section if the discharge is for the p. 1 SB 6292purpose of transferring the person for continued detention andtreatment under this chapter at another treatment facility.
